Sociologically, this creates a hierarchy of truth where sacred claims are insulated from falsification, while empirical evidence is treated as optional or suspect. The text becomes unfalsifiable by design, which is the opposite of how knowledge progresses in healthy societies.

78544.context: And whether that source has sufficient authority to override reality. This is not just a theological posture. It becomes a transferable habit that affects politics, relationships, and personal decision making. At a societal level, Genesis creation narrative helps normalize a worldview where explanation flows from power rather than evidence. If the universe itself is framed as something understood through revelation rather than investigation, then questioning foundational claims feels not just incorrect, but disloyal.

78544.title: Everything Wrong With Genesis (Because Everything After Depends On It)

78545.context: Let's take Adam and Eve, for example. The Adam and Eve story in Genesis is often treated as a simple moral parable, but structurally, it functions as a psychological blueprint, one that collapses under scrutiny. There is no evidence for a first human couple, no support from population genetics for humanity descending from two individuals, and no plausible framework in which a talking serpent and a magical tree dispensing moral knowledge makes any sense. These elements are not symbolic add-ons, they are the mechanism of the story.
78545.creator: darante-lamar
78545.title: Everything Wrong With Genesis (Because Everything After Depends On It)

78546.context: The flood narrative in Genesis represents the clearest collision between mythic storytelling and moral catastrophe. Scientifically, the story collapses on every front. There is no global geological flood layer, no evidence of a worldwide deluge within the proposed time frame, no feasible way to house feed and preserve millions of species on a single wooden vessel, and no plausible genetic pathway for life to rebound from such an extreme bottleneck without immediate extinction level consequences.
78546.creator: darante-lamar
78546.title: Everything Wrong With Genesis (Because Everything After Depends On It)

78547.context: Sociologically, literalism functions as a gatekeeping mechanism. If Genesis must be literally true to be spiritually valid, then questioning it becomes a moral failure rather than an intellectual one. This shifts debate from evidence to loyalty and from understanding to obedience. Communities built on this framework rewards certainty over curiosity and conformity over comprehension. The text becomes less of a source of wisdom and more a test of allegiance.
78547.creator: darante-lamar
78547.title: Everything Wrong With Genesis (Because Everything After Depends On It)

78548.context: Psychologically, this creates existential pressure to preserve Genesis at all cost. When a belief system is built like a lobe-bearing structure, removing the foundation threatens collapse higher up. This produces defensive reasoning when evidence is filtered, not by accuracy, but by threat level. Questions about Genesis are treated as spiritual danger signals, not intellectual inquiries. Doubt becomes moralized because it destabilizes identity, purpose, and cosmic meaning all at once.

78548.title: Everything Wrong With Genesis (Because Everything After Depends On It)

78549.context: It's not protected as truth, it's protected as infrastructure. And once that becomes clear, the debate shifts.
